page.layout: One printed page: a single list of lettered explanations (key to a figure), each letter in the left column, its description in italic to the right. No margins with text, no running head, no page number.

main_text.l: F. Exitus ductus bilarii intestinalis in inte-stino duodeno.
G. Exitus Ductus Pancreatici in intestino.
KK. Vincula supra ductum intestinalem, & intra exitum ductus pancreatici in-testinum duodenum constringentia.

page.notes: Letters at left (D, E, F, G, HH, II, KK, L, M, N, O) are printed in large capitals and are list keys, given as <l>. Long s rendered as plain s. The "&" in KK is a printed ampersand glyph. Words broken at line ends keep their printed hyphens: "inte-stino", "di-stentum", "in-testinum". The "F," letter may be a comma-like mark in the scan; read as F. "flaxida" as printed (probably flaccida).
